summary: Tested the Telugu/Kannada Whisper script-mismatch warning fix. (1) Backend: wrote 19 pytest unit tests directly importing script_guard.check_script_mismatch()/detect_script() covering Telugu-selected-Kannada-detected (the exact reported bug), matching-script no-mismatch cases for Hindi/English/Marathi/Urdu, short-transcript (<6 chars) never-flagged rule, unmapped/None language codes, and boundary (exactly 6 vs 5 chars) — ALL 19 PASSED. (2) Code review of server.py /voice/transcribe: correctly calls check_script_mismatch(result.text, language) and merges script_mismatch/detected_script/expected_script into response on both the language-hint success path and the retry-without-hint fallback path. (3) Code review of frontend index.tsx: both web-recording (line ~1061) and native-recording (whisperTranscribeFile, line ~1080) branches correctly set transcriptMismatch state from the new response fields; modal renders testID='transcript-mismatch-warning' banner only when mismatch present, and testID='transcript-send-btn' label correctly toggles 'Correct — send' <-> 'Send anyway'; cancel/edit handlers correctly reset transcriptMismatch. (4) Regression: full E2E UI test — selected Telugu language, logged in with voicetest2026@example.com, sent a text chat message ('What is the fine for riding without a helmet?') via testID='send-button', got correct Telugu-language RAG answer with verified citation (MV 194D) — confirms chat/RAG/citations/login/language-selection are fully unaffected by this change, no console errors, no red screen. (5) Backend endpoint reachability confirmed: POST /api/voice/transcribe without auth correctly returns 401 'Missing token' (endpoint alive, auth-gated as expected). Real microphone audio recording -> Whisper call could not be tested per known environment limitation (documented by requesting agent) — verification relied on unit-level script_guard logic + code inspection of both call sites, per the agreed approach.
action_items: No blocking issues found. Optional: consider adding a server-side integration test that mocks the Whisper client response to exercise the full /api/voice/transcribe endpoint's script_mismatch merging logic (currently only unit-tested via direct script_guard import, since real Whisper calls aren't fake-able in this env).
critical_code_review_comments: script_guard.py is well-documented, pure/stateless, and correctly handles the short-transcript false-positive risk via _MIN_LETTERS_TO_JUDGE=6.
server.py correctly applies check_script_mismatch on BOTH the initial-attempt and retry-without-language-hint code paths, so the warning still works even when Whisper rejects the language hint.
Frontend correctly resets transcriptMismatch state on cancel/edit/send actions, avoiding stale warning state leaking into the next voice transcription.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing voicetest2026@example.com test account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: script_guard.py logic is solid and unit-tested (19/19 pass). Frontend modal code inspected and correct for both web/native paths but NOT visually verified with a real script-mismatch banner render (impossible without real mic audio triggering an actual Whisper mis-transcription in this env) — if a future agent gains audio-injection capability, prioritize an E2E test that records Telugu audio and confirms the mismatch banner actually renders with testID='transcript-mismatch-warning' and detected_script populated correctly.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration verified a fix, not a bug. Original bug: Whisper occasionally mis-transcribes Telugu audio into Kannada script due to script similarity; fix adds check_script_mismatch() Unicode-range-based detection comparing the transcript's dominant script against the expected script for the selected language, surfaced as a non-blocking warning banner in the 'We heard' modal.
